title: Finite exterior coefficient tower versus the dual positive tensor tower
statement: For a scheme X, adic coefficient datum d over A, and a finite list a : Fin r → A, let F be inverse coefficient restriction followed by the explicitly constructed small-site equivalence [def-weil-pbc-completed-cech-site-transport], H its action on complexes, O the transported completed ring and b the compatible-residue sections. The transported finite exterior coefficient complexes H(completedKoszulPowerSheaf(m)) are isomorphic to the strict dual positive tensor tower at m. The isomorphisms commute with the consecutive exterior power transitions. The transported degree-zero exterior augmentation, preceded by the regular-module section 1, equals the degree-zero component of the dual tensor augmentation. No arbitrary input complex is present. Empty lists, zero rings, and arbitrary generator lists are allowed.

source.place: More on Algebra, Tag 0664, lemma-join-sequences-koszul-complex; Tag 0A0E, proof of lemma-derived-completion-koszul: the finite free dual identification, before tensoring with E.

proof.text: Obtain the algebraic exterior-to-negative-tensor comparison and map its isomorphisms through the composite of completed constant extension, inverse coefficient restriction and site equivalence. Compose with the rank-one tensor-to-dual transport. Functoriality and associativity combine the two consecutive transition squares.

Expand completedKoszulSheafUnitZero as completedKoszulOne followed by the constant functor applied to finiteKoszulExteriorUnitZero. Functor.map_comp and the algebraic unit equality convert this to the recursive tensor unit. The tensor-dual transport unit equality gives exactly the required degree-zero equation.

lean.statement: theorem completedKoszulCoefficientComparison (X : Scheme.{u}) {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) : let F := intrinsicPresentationModulesBack X d ⋙ (completedCechModulesEquiv X d).functor let H := F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) let O := completedCechRing X d let b := fun i ↦ completedCechScalar X d (a i) let K := completedKoszulPowerSheaf X (intrinsicPresentationDatum d) r a ∃ e : ∀ m : ℕ, H.obj (K m) ≅ (ringedKoszulDualTower O r b).obj (op m), (∀ m, H.map (((completedKoszulConstant X (intrinsicPresentationDatum d)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map (completedKoszulTransition (A := A) r a m)) ≫ (e m).hom = (e (m + 1)).hom ≫ (ringedKoszulDualTower O r b).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ m)).op) ∧ (∀ m, completedCechCoefficientUnit X d ≫ F.map (completedKoszulSheafUnitZero X (intrinsicPresentationDatum d) r a m) ≫ (e m).hom.f 0 = (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (.up ℤ) 0 _).inv ≫ (ringedKoszulDualUnit O r b m).f 0)
